tasks.title: Add WIP commit methods to WorktreeManager
tasks.description: Add createWipCommit(worktreePath, taskId, attemptNumber), findWipCommit(worktreePath, taskId), and getWipDiffSummary(worktreePath, taskId) methods to WorktreeManager. createWipCommit does git add -A + commit with author mohist-wip, returns hash or null if no changes. findWipCommit searches git log for matching WIP: T-XXX timeout* messages. getWipDiffSummary returns diff --stat for the WIP commit.
acceptanceCriteria: createWipCommit creates commit with message 'WIP: T-XXX timeout (attempt N)' and author 'mohist-wip <mohist@wip>'
createWipCommit returns null when worktree has no uncommitted changes
createWipCommit returns commit hash when changes exist
findWipCommit returns { hash, message, changedFiles, diffStat } for most recent matching commit
findWipCommit returns null when no WIP commit exists for the task
getWipDiffSummary returns file list with add/delete line counts
Git commit failures in createWipCommit are caught and return null without throwing
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use execFileAsync pattern already in worktree-manager.ts. Exclude openspec/changes/ and .opencode/ from git add, matching mergeBack() behavior.

tasks.title: Add onBeforeKill callback to acp-session timeout path
tasks.description: Add onBeforeKill?: (cwd: string) => Promise<boolean> callback to AcpSessionOptions and wipCommitted?: boolean to AcpSessionResult. In both single-session and multi-round timeout paths, call onBeforeKill before cleanup(). If callback returns true, set wipCommitted=true on result. Wrap callback call in try/catch so failures don't block process cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: onBeforeKill callback is invoked before cleanup() in single-session timeout path (acp-session.ts ~line 370-387)
onBeforeKill callback is invoked before cleanup in multi-round prompt timeout path (acp-session.ts ~line 754-775)
AcpSessionResult.wipCommitted is true when onBeforeKill returns true
AcpSessionResult.wipCommitted is false/undefined when timeout occurs without onBeforeKill callback
onBeforeKill failure (exception) is caught and logged as warning, does not prevent process cleanup
No behavioral change when onBeforeKill is not provided (backward compatible)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The callback receives cwd (the worktree path). Return true if WIP commit was created, false otherwise. Keep the existing timeout flow unchanged — just insert the callback call between connection.cancel() and cleanup().

tasks.title: Add WIP resume context to context-assembler
tasks.description: Add wipResumeContext?: string field to BuildContextOptions. In buildTaskContext(), when wipResumeContext is provided, inject a [WIP Resume] section between the learnings section and the task/retry section. The section tells the agent which files were already modified and that it should continue from the current state.
acceptanceCriteria: BuildContextOptions has wipResumeContext optional string field
When wipResumeContext is provided, [WIP Resume] section appears in assembled prompt
[WIP Resume] section is placed after learnings and before task/retry content
When wipResumeContext is not provided, prompt is identical to current behavior
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The caller (ralph-executor) is responsible for building the wipResumeContext string from findWipCommit result. The assembler just injects it as-is.

tasks.title: Integrate WIP commit into ralph-executor retry logic
tasks.description: Add timeout_with_wip failure category to FAILURE_CATEGORY_CONFIGS with { maxAttempts: 2, retryable: true }. When calling runAcpSession, pass onBeforeKill callback that calls WorktreeManager.createWipCommit(). In categorizeFailure, detect timeout_with_wip when error contains 'timeout' and the result has wipCommitted=true. On timeout_with_wip retry, call findWipCommit() to get diff info, build wipResumeContext string, and pass it to buildTaskContext().
acceptanceCriteria: FAILURE_CATEGORY_CONFIGS has timeout_with_wip entry with maxAttempts: 2, retryable: true
onBeforeKill callback passed to runAcpSession calls createWipCommit with task ID and attempt number
categorizeFailure returns timeout_with_wip when result.wipCommitted is true
categorizeFailure returns timeout (unchanged) when result.wipCommitted is false or undefined
On timeout_with_wip retry, prompt includes WIP resume context from findWipCommit
On timeout_without_wip retry, behavior is unchanged (non-retryable, pauses build)
RalphExecutorContext receives worktreeManager instance for WIP operations
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Add WorktreeManager to RalphExecutorContext. The onBeforeKill callback needs access to worktreePath (from context), taskId (from current task), and attempt number (from loop variable). Use closure to capture these values.

tasks.title: Write unit tests for WIP commit flow
tasks.description: Write unit tests covering: createWipCommit with/without changes, findWipCommit with/without existing WIP, timeout_with_wip categorization, and WIP resume context in assembled prompts. Use existing test patterns from the codebase.
acceptanceCriteria: Test createWipCommit: creates commit with correct message and author when changes exist
Test createWipCommit: returns null when no changes
Test findWipCommit: returns commit info when WIP commit exists
Test findWipCommit: returns null when no WIP commit
Test categorizeFailure: returns timeout_with_wip for timeout error with wipCommitted=true
Test categorizeFailure: returns timeout for timeout error with wipCommitted=false
Test buildTaskContext: includes [WIP Resume] section when wipResumeContext provided
Test buildTaskContext: no [WIP Resume] section when wipResumeContext absent
All tests pass
